Game Overview

In Somewhere, the core idea is straightforward: enter the minimalist yet challenging world of Somewhere, where every level demands strategic navigation through intricate obstacles. Survive without enemies in a 1-bit universe that tests your timing, patience, and determination. Uncover hidden secrets as you master seven levels with precision and thoughtful execution to succeed.
